thesisQuality.note: Record $1.9B backlog, $307M Q2 bookings and $410M of July hyperscale leases evidence durable demand, but commencement lag and capital intensity prevent exceptional treatment.

financialOperatingMomentum.note: Revenue +29% YoY, 25.4% renewal cash-rent growth and raised Core FFO outlook are strong, offset by roughly $18.6B debt and equity-financed growth.

marketValuationOpportunity.note: At about $182.12/share and $68.78B market cap, valuation already capitalizes substantial growth; strong demand is balanced by debt, dilution and execution requirements.

catalystScore.note: Large signed backlog, July hyperscale leases and raised 2026 Core FFO outlook provide multiple source-supported catalysts with identifiable conversion periods.

governancePower.note: Public disclosure and board compensation governance are documented, while large capital deployment and equity issuance warrant only adequate-to-strong rather than exceptional stewardship scoring.

alignment2036.note: Powered data-center capacity, interconnection and multi-gigawatt development directly serve durable AI/cloud infrastructure demand across plausible 2036 futures.

crossDivisionLeverage.note: The platform reuses data-center, connectivity and development capabilities across hyperscale and broader digital-infrastructure demand, though hyperscale concentration remains a material dependency.

bottleneckControl.note: Customers are reserving future powered capacity while company expansion targets scarce utility power and land, indicating strong control of a real infrastructure constraint.

scenarioRobustness.note: Global digital-infrastructure demand and broad capacity reuse support several demand scenarios, but power, construction, financing and customer commencement remain shared dependencies.

substitutionResilience.note: Large-scale powered campuses and interconnection are difficult to replace quickly, but customers retain alternative data-center providers and self-build options.

supplyChainResilience.note: The company has multiple development markets and capital pathways, but utility power and construction are explicit successor bottlenecks and campus-level interconnection timing remains uncertain.

pricingPower.note: Renewal cash rents increased 25.4%, providing direct evidence of strong price realization amid constrained capacity.

risk.note: Material debt, equity issuance, backlog commencement lag, power/construction dependencies and normalization items create meaningful but non-thesis-breaking execution and per-share risk.

confidence.note: Identity is validated and operating claims are grounded in current primary issuer evidence with a distinct SEC governance source and independent current market valuation; customer concentration and campus power schedules remain undisclosed.

thesis: Digital Realty controls scarce powered and interconnected data-center capacity positioned for durable AI/cloud demand, with record backlog and strong renewal pricing offset by capital intensity and power-delivery execution risk.
keyRisk: Backlog conversion and per-share value depend on timely power/construction delivery and disciplined returns on debt/equity-funded expansion.
nextCatalyst: Conversion of signed hyperscale backlog and delivery against raised 2026 Core FFO/share guidance.

scoreBreakdown.note: Earth score uses weighted component score less methodology risk penalty; data confidence is separately recorded and remains above the publication floor.
